title: Objectwise contracting identity for the chosen-product free Cech complex
statement: For a category C with hom-sets in universe v, a family f(i)→U and chosen site Cech products S [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex], a ring presheaf R:Cᵒᵖ→RingCat.{v} [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification], n:ℕ and X:Cᵒᵖ, there are R(X)-linear maps h:K(n+1)(X)→K(n+2)(X) and k:K(n)(X)→K(n+1)(X), where K is the constructed alternating free complex on tuple representable sums, with h≫d(n+2,n+1)(X)+d(n+1,n)(X)≫k=id. No naturality in X is asserted.

source.place: Tags 03AT and 03F5, fibre decomposition and prefix contracting homotopy

proof.text: For a basis tuple x=(t,a) at X, form its common composite φ:X→U. Its zeroth projection proves that φ has a lift to some f(i). Choose such a lift as a function of φ alone (proof irrelevance makes the choice independent of the existence proof). Prefix that lift to the projections of x, and use the chosen product universal property to construct the unique resulting basis tuple. No choice is required for composites with no lift, since they have no basis tuples.

Product uniqueness and indexMap_pr show that deleting the first coordinate of the prefix returns x. Deleting coordinate i+1 commutes with prefixing after deleting coordinate i: deletion preserves the common composite φ and hence the selected lift. These identities include the case of degree-zero source tuples. The private helpers tupleFace_prefix_zero and tupleFace_prefix_succ prove both identities.

Apply Mathlib ModuleCat.free to the prefix and deletion functions at X. Functoriality preserves their composition identities. The additive evaluation functor expresses the differential as the sum of the free deletion maps with integer coefficients (-1)^i. Split the sum into the first face and successor faces using Fin.sum_univ_succ. The first term is the identity; the successor terms are the negatives of the second homotopy composite and cancel. This produces the required h and k without constructing or transporting through a direct-sum isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03AT and 03F5; direct prefix construction and alternating-sign cancellation on the chosen-product tuple basis

theorem freeComplex_evaluation_contracting (R : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ RingCat.{v})
    (n : ℕ) (X : Cᵒᵖ) :
    ∃ h : ((S.freeComplex R).X (n + 1)).obj X ⟶
        ((S.freeComplex R).X (n + 2)).obj X,
      ∃ k : ((S.freeComplex R).X n).obj X ⟶
          ((S.freeComplex R).X (n + 1)).obj X,
        h ≫ ((S.freeComplex R).d (n + 2) (n + 1)).app X +
          ((S.freeComplex R).d (n + 1) n).app X ≫ k = 𝟙 _
